the decision for renting and owning a dwelling is not a simple one.

(1) the propensity for renters in the Netherlands to buy a dwelling is positively influenced by changes in the economic situation of the household, and by changes in the housing market situation, and (2) the propensity for owners in the Netherlands to sell a dwelling is positively related to changes in the housing career, in the economic situation and in the housing market.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the decision of households for renting or owning a dwelling, and the influence of housing market circumstances on the timing of this decision.
the question whether the decision to rent a dwelling is made on rational grounds.
the housing careers of households.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the decision of households for renting or for buying a dwelling is a complex process in which many factors play a role.
the decision of households about renting or buying a dwelling is a result of a combination of the life course of the household, housing market circumstances and government policy.
the decision of households whether to rent or to own is a result of a complex process, in which the economic circumstances and the household's housing consumption are interrelated.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the life course of a household and the life course of the housing market have to be taken together to understand the decision of a household to rent or to own a dwelling.
the decision to move from renting to buying a dwelling is influenced by both the life course of a household and by the economic circumstances in which the decision is made.
we found that life course and housing market conditions are important determinants in the decision to move from renting to buying.
The main takeaway from our work is that
housing policy can influence the decision of households whether to rent or to own a dwelling.
the housing market is an important determinant of the decision to rent versus own.
housing market conditions are an important factor in the decision of renters to buy a house.
